help.title: Help
help.signin.a: Press Sign in with Google and choose the Gmail address the colony has registered for you. If it says No access, ask the President or Secretary to add that Gmail.
help.complaint.q: How do I raise a complaint?
help.complaint.a: Open Issues, press the plus button, write what is wrong, add a photo if you like, and send. You can follow its progress in the same place.
help.vote.q: How do I vote in a poll?
help.vote.a: Open Community, then Polls. Choose an option and confirm. Each member has one vote, whatever the number of plots. You cannot change a vote after you confirm.
help.maintenance.q: Where do I see my maintenance?
help.maintenance.a: Open Money. It shows what you have paid, what is due this month, and any other fees to pay.
help.broken.q: If the app is not working
help.broken.a: You can still read colony records in Google Drive with your own Gmail. Ask the committee for the link, then try the app again later.
help.fallback.q: If the app is down: read records in Google Drive
help.fallback.intro: The colony records are ordinary Google Sheets that you can open with the same Gmail you use to sign in. They are view-only: you cannot change anything there.
help.fallback.s1: Ask any committee member for the colony Drive folder link and open it while signed in to your registered Gmail.
help.fallback.s2: Open the folders Data and Media. You will find Expenses, Complaints, Events, Meetings, Plots, Polls and the colony maintenance totals.
help.fallback.s3: If it says You need access, you are signed in to a different Google account. Switch to the Gmail the colony registered for you.
help.fallback.s4: To raise a complaint, pay or vote, wait until the app works again, or speak to a committee member.
help.fallback.note: Your own payments and dues, and the votes of other members, are not in these files. Only the app shows them.
